- **Scheduled warm-up pings:** they're cheap, but they don't guarantee a warm instance, and they only help at the concurrency they generate.
- **Real-time endpoint:** if traffic is steady enough that the endpoint is rarely idle, an always-on instance may cost about the same and be more predictable.
